offhandtweaks.config.title: Offhand Tweaks — Client Config
offhandtweaks.config.allowShieldRMB.tool: When true (default), right-clicking with a shield in the offhand raises the shield (vanilla). When false, the offhand shield does nothing on RMB.
offhandtweaks.config.allowLightSourcesRM: When true, torches / lanterns / lamps / candles placed from the offhand behave as in vanilla. When false, RMB with light sources in the offhand is blocked.
offhandtweaks.config.allowFoodRMB.toolti: When true (default), edible items can be eaten from the offhand. When false, RMB with food in the offhand is blocked.
offhandtweaks.config.allowOtherBlocksRMB: When true, any offhand item not covered by the other categories activates on RMB as in vanilla. When false, those items are blocked.
